reason: User asked whether DFTB3 is unreliable and whether representative model calculations should be run

The 2025 Arantes/Rezac JCTC benchmark reports overall isolated-PT MUEs of 15.2 kJ/mol for DFTB3 and 13.5 kJ/mol for GFN2-xTB, but for the -NH3 subset DFTB3 is 14.4 and GFN2-xTB 22.2 kJ/mol, so GFN2 is not automatically better for the relevant ammonium chemistry.
